canonical.name: Compactly supported transverse Fourier packet, Coulomb potential, regularity and finite energy
canonical.support: The item defines the compact spectral support away from k=0, proves Schwartz decay by integration by parts, verifies the Maxwell amplitudes modewise, and checks SI units and finite energy.

canonical.name: Exact helicity projectors and their time/rotation covariance
canonical.support: The item defines the transverse fibre and C(k), then proves self-adjointness, projector identities, ranks, and commutation without choosing a global polarization frame.

canonical.name: Coulomb-gauge kinetic, canonical orbital and canonical spin functionals
canonical.support: The item fixes the all-space integral convention, convergence, SI units, origin, and gauge-restricted meaning of the three functionals.

canonical.name: Finite-cube divergence/surface identity and source-free total-integral equality
canonical.support: The proof derives the component identity by the Levi-Civita formula and coordinatewise integration by parts, then passes to Schwartz decay.

canonical.name: Nonzero monochromatic plane wave outside the finite-energy functional domain
canonical.support: The counterexample uses the inspected plane-wave energy-average theorem and preserves its infinite-total-energy qualification.

canonical.name: Smooth charged time-slice with nonzero divergence correction
canonical.support: The example applies Gauss's adopted Maxwell equation to the exact finite-cube identity and constructs compactly supported smooth data with a nonzero charge term.
